title: 第7章 咽不下这口气第8章 疯狂突破聚元九重
lines: 莫轻柔是九年前来到炎阳书院。
只因双腿不便，平日里也未曾显山露水，年龄不大，也就二十出头，导致书院很多弟子都不曾注意。
但叶寒却很清楚，老师对于修炼的理解极其不凡，远不是书院中其他那些老师所能比肩的。
“嗯，我以前是轮回书院的真传弟子，不过，在九年前的阴阳榜之战中重伤，双腿被人以极寒狱水所侵，导致无法走路，境界跌落，后面便来了炎阳书院。”
莫轻柔笑看着叶寒，说起这些倒是风轻云淡：“老师听着多老啊，若是你真能加入轮回书院，倒应该称我为师姐才对。”
“额……。”叶寒一怔。
“今日亲眼目睹罗天征的姿态，又听老师这样说，我倒对轮回书院没什么好感，这太虚古域中，可还有其他大宗门加入？”叶寒继续道。
“有，神武大陆广袤无边，神山大川不知何几，诸般教、宗、书院、圣地各自镇压一方。”
“然而，你除却轮回书院，无处可去。”莫轻柔回应道。
“无处可去？”
叶寒皱眉。
莫轻柔道：“各大势力多不胜数，但大多浪得虚名，且地域广袤，凭你现在的实力，以及我这般行动不便的状态，离开炎阳城，只有死路一条。”
“我可独自前去，无需老师庇佑。”
叶寒目光坚定。
“你为炎阳书院弟子，属轮回书院麾下，无人敢与轮回书院抢弟子。”
莫轻柔说出残酷的现实。
“行，轮回书院还有十天招收弟子，我好好准备一下。”
叶寒无奈开口。
炎阳书院作为轮回书院的分院之一，每年都会有使者前来招收弟子，名额只有一个，基本上是每年炎阳书院众弟子中最强的那个。
以前的叶寒，只能算是优秀，但不管年龄还是其他方面，实则都和那些老牌内门弟子有差距，但现在他自信可通过考核，获取到轮回书院使者认可。
老师说的没错，神武大陆太大了，炎城不过是弹丸之地，就算坐上炎城之主的位置，在那些高高在上的大势力强者眼中也不过是笑话。
如那罗天征，这狗东西在轮回书院只是普通弟子，可来了炎城却简直是颐指气使无视一切，一念之间定夺他人生死，连城主都要毕恭毕敬，不敢招惹。
若非老师在场，现在的自己恐怕都已经被杀死，何谈未来？
还有，叶芷萱这恶毒的女人，夺了天蛟战骨直接一飞冲天，被轮回书院的大人物所看重，就这样活着离开了？
简直是踩着自己的头颅上位。
对于叶寒来说如鲠在喉，他咽不下这口气。
“我去了轮回书院，第一件大事就是将你们挫骨扬灰。”叶寒暗自握紧了拳头。
受到九天御龙诀以及龙帝气息的滋养，叶寒的本尊意志无形中受到影响，早已沾染几分帝王气概，不能说心比天高，但也不愿受他人欺压与奴役。
没有实力，永远都要被他人压着，整日畏首畏尾，甚至苟延残喘。
九界镇龙塔中，龙族传说中至高无上手段通天的龙帝都被活生生镇死，自己如今算什么？
龙帝死了，尚有威名可传万世千秋，自己这种小人物死就死了，没有谁能记得。
来生缥缈，只求此生，何不过的潇潇洒洒，酣畅淋漓？
“叶寒，你的元力很雄厚，虽然能击败叶阳甫，不过炎阳书院也有几个不弱于叶阳甫的老牌内门弟子，若要彻底夺取那个资格，的确要重视，短短十天境界是无法增长，但可从武技方面入手。”
content_en:
Mo Qingrou came to Yanyang Academy nine years ago.
Because of the inconvenience of his legs, he has never shown much publicity on weekdays, and he is still young, only in his early twenties. As a result, many disciples in the academy did not pay attention to him.
But Ye Han knew very well that the teacher's understanding of cultivation was extremely extraordinary, far beyond what other teachers in the academy could match.
"Well, I used to be a true disciple of Samsara Academy. However, I was seriously injured in the battle of Yin and Yang nine years ago. My legs were invaded by extremely cold hell water, which made me unable to walk and my realm fell. Then I came to Yanyang Academy."
Mo Qingrou looked at Ye Han with a smile, and said this calmly: "Teacher, you sound so old. If you can really join the Reincarnation Academy, you should call me senior sister."
"Uh..." Ye Han was startled.
"After witnessing Luo Tianzheng's posture today, and hearing what the teacher said, I don't have a good impression of Samsara Academy. Are there other major sects in the Taixu Ancient Domain that have joined?" Ye Han continued.
"Yes, the Shenwu Continent is vast and boundless. There are countless sacred mountains and rivers. All kinds of religions, sects, academies, and holy places suppress each one."
"However, you have nowhere to go but Reincarnation Academy." Mo Qingrou responded.
"Nowhere to go?"
Ye Han frowned.
Mo Qingrou said: "There are countless major forces, but most of them are in vain, and their territory is vast. With your current strength and my inconvenient state of movement, leaving Yanyang City is the only way to die."
"I can go alone without the teacher's protection."
Ye Han's eyes were firm.
"You are a disciple of Yanyang Academy and you belong to Samsara Academy. No one dares to compete with Samsara Academy for disciples."
Mo Qingrou told the cruel reality.
"Okay, Samsara Academy still has ten days to recruit disciples, so I'll make good preparations."
Ye Han spoke helplessly.
Yanyang Academy is one of the branches of Samsara Academy. Every year, messengers come to recruit disciples. There is only one quota, which is basically the strongest one among the disciples of Yanyang Academy every year.
In the past, Ye Han could only be regarded as excellent, but regardless of age or other aspects, there was actually a gap between him and those veteran inner disciples. But now he is confident that he can pass the assessment and be recognized by the messenger of Samsara Academy.
The teacher is right, the Shenwu Continent is too big, and Yancheng is just a small place. Even if he takes the position of the Lord of Yancheng, it is just a joke in the eyes of those powerful and powerful people.
Like Na Luo Tianzheng, this bitch was just an ordinary disciple in Samsara Academy, but when he came to Yancheng, he was so arrogant that he ignored everything and decided the life and death of others in a single thought. Even the city lord had to be respectful and didn't dare to provoke him.
If it weren't for the teacher's presence, I would have been killed now, so how could we talk about the future?
Also, Ye Zhixuan, a vicious woman, snatched the Heavenly Dragon Battle Bones and flew straight into the sky. She was valued by the big shots at Samsara Academy and left alive like this?
He was simply stepping on his own head to get to the top.
For Ye Han, it was like a lump in his throat, and he couldn't swallow this breath.
"I went to Reincarnation Academy, and the first important thing was to crush you to ashes." Ye Han secretly clenched his fists.
Nourished by the Nine Heavens Dragon Control Technique and the Dragon Emperor's aura, Ye Han's true will was invisibly affected, and he had already become somewhat imperial. He could not say that his heart was higher than the sky, but he also did not want to be oppressed and enslaved by others.
Without strength, you will always be suppressed by others, timid all day long, or even living on your last breath.
In the Nine Realms Dragon Suppression Tower, the Dragon Emperor, the supreme master in the dragon legend, was suppressed alive. Who do you think he is now?
The Dragon Emperor is dead, but he still has a reputation that can be passed down for eternity. If a small person like him dies, he will die and no one will remember him.
The next life is elusive, and if you only want this life, why not be carefree and lively?
"Ye Han, your Yuan Power is very strong. Although you can defeat Ye Yangfu, Yanyang Academy also has several veteran inner disciples who are not weaker than Ye Yangfu. If you want to completely seize that qualification, you must pay attention. You cannot increase your realm in just ten days, but you can start with martial arts."
